data.why: The app has no file upload or data-loading code; all signaling parameters, scaffold/ligand options, CRISPR target tables, and dark-proteome/molecular-validation tables are hardcoded dicts/DataFrames in app.py, and simulations run purely on slider-set kinetic constants.

goals: Simulate CD40-TRAF6-NF-kB-SOCS1 kinetics under a chosen scaffold and CD40 agonist, and read off steady-state NF-kB and time-to-peak
Compare the SOCS1-feedback model against a null (no-feedback) model to see whether NF-kB attenuates or plateaus chronically
Run a 50-iteration Monte Carlo robustness sweep over +/-20% kinetic parameter perturbation and inspect mean peak, time-to-peak, and AUC distributions
Compute CRISPR knockout synergy scores (SOCS1, PD-L1, CTLA-4, IL-10) via AUC-based Bliss-independence-style scoring and rank targets
Sweep k1 and k4 individually to assess sensitivity of steady-state NF-kB to receptor-proximal and decay rate constants
Export a text summary of the current scaffold/ligand/parameter configuration and modeling notes

review.summary: The tree states what the tool is for in tool-neutral terms that match the README (RK4 ODE with SOCS1 feedback, null model, ±20% Monte Carlo, AUC knockout synergy), and the eight sampled screens support their nodes. One factual error needs fixing before filing: the damping ratio is k3/k4, not k8/k4. The tree should also state plainly that vehicle and agonist choices never reach the model, and add the parameter-justification table.
